claims.report_quote: TreeRAG employs a tree-like hierarchical structure for document chunking, where text is segmented into a root-to-leaf and leaf-to-root traversal framework known as Bidirectional Traversal Retrieval.
claims.claim: TreeRAG uses a tree‑like hierarchical structure with bidirectional traversal (root‑to‑leaf and leaf‑to‑root) for document chunking.

claims.report_quote: TreeRAG’s bidirectional strategy enables the system to explore both local and global context during retrieval, reducing redundancy and improving semantic coherence.
claims.claim: Bidirectional traversal in TreeRAG allows exploration of both local and global context, reducing redundancy and enhancing semantic coherence.
